research.searchCoverage: Official Quaderno API (HTTP Basic to ACCOUNT_NAME.quadernoapp.com/api plus GET https://quadernoapp.com/api/authorization), contacts and items/products, Recrea Systems SL Spanish identity, Visma acquisition, and dated incident search for Quaderno security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying unresolved customer-account compromise found. Not a breach-free claim.

Official Quaderno REST API authentication (HTTP Basic, account subdomain host), GET /authorization on quadernoapp.com, GET /contacts and GET /items, Recrea Systems SL Las Palmas identity and 2023 Visma acquisition, and dated incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying unresolved incident found for this product. Not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Healthcheck uses official GET https://quadernoapp.com/api/authorization with per-operation baseUrl. Official docs specify HTTP Basic username apiKey and a blank password; pinned source sends apiKey:x. Native recipe follows official docs. Sandbox *.sandbox-quadernoapp.com is not admitted.

Uses required stored accountSubdomain interpolated as https://{{accountSubdomain}}.quadernoapp.com/api (Algolia-style). Optional q and processor_id are official query filters. Provider next-page URLs are never followed.
id is encoded as the path segment. Raw Quaderno JSON is returned under data.
Official products list is GET /items. Optional q is the documented search query. Raw JSON array is returned under data.
Official product get is GET /items/{id}. Raw JSON is returned under data.
